observations.content: Kofi has a German legal contract open in a translation editor. The glossary panel lists about forty new legal terms.
Kofi writes a reply declining a video call on Friday and proposes Tuesday morning instead.
Calendar for the week: no meetings on Friday; three two-hour focus blocks on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.
Kofi edits the translation file between 22:00 and 01:30 on two consecutive nights before a delivery.
In a chat reply, Kofi asks for the delivery deadline to be confirmed in writing.
A review call is moved from Friday to Monday.
